desc: Reduce a target score `x` to visit demands `d[i] = ceil(x / points[i])` and establish monotonicity for binary search.
Derive and justify the fixed-endpoint edge-flow greedy recurrence and move-count formula.
Derive an O(n) minimization of the fixed-endpoint cost using the final two endpoints.
Determine safe binary-search bounds and integer arithmetic details for `ceil(x / points[i])`.
Implement `Solution.maxScore` in Python with `O(n log answer)` complexity.
Run provided sample tests and exhaustive/brute-force validation for small random cases, including `n = 2`, small `m`, and endpoint edge cases.
